 Kareena Kapoor Khan flaunts sindoor; celebrates Diwali with parents Randhir-Babita; Jeh wishes media 'Happy Diwali'
 Kareena Kapoor celebrated Diwali with sister Karisma Kapoor and parents Babita and Randhir Kapoor at a family lunch. The sisters also shared festive moments on social media, while Jeh's sweet Diwali wish to the paparazzi caught attention.
 By 
 Ruchita 
 November 8, 2026 16:16 IST 
 Diwali 2026: Kareena Kapoor Khan flaunts sindoor, poses with paps; Jeh wishes media 'Happy Diwali'; Randhir-Babita papped Instagram 
 The Kapoor family celebrated Diwali together, sharing warm moments from their festive gathering on social media. On Sunday, Kareena Kapoor and Karisma Kapoor joined their parents, Babita and Randhir Kapoor, for a Diwali lunch.
 Several pictures and videos of Babita and Randhir wishing the paparazzi a happy Diwali have surfaced on social media. Kareena also greeted the photographers and posed with her sister Karisma, giving fans a glimpse of the family's festive celebrations.
 Diwali with Kapoors: Kareena Kapoor Khan flaunts sindoor; celebrates Diwali with parents Randhir-Babita; Jeh wishes media 'Happy Diwali' Instagram 
 For Diwali, Kareena opted for a green suit paired with a red dupatta; she also wore sindoor.
 Another clip shows Kareena posing with paps. Karisma chose a lighter shade of green. Randhir Kapoor kept his look traditional in a white outfit, while Babita looked elegant in pink.
 Kareena took to her Instagram and shared heartwarming pictures with her parents and sister Karima. A photo also shows Taimur hugging grandfather Randhir Kapoor.
 View this post on Instagram A post shared by Kareena Kapoor Khan (@kareenakapoorkhan) 
 Earlier, on Saturday, Kareena stepped out for lunch with husband Saif Ali Khan and their sons, Jeh and Taimur. In a sweet moment that caught everyone's attention, Jeh surprised the paparazzi by wishing them a happy Diwali.
 View this post on Instagram A post shared by Instant Bollywood (@instantbollywood) 
 Kareena-Karisma Kapoor Twins in yellow traditional outfits on Dhanteras 
 On Dhanteras, Kareena Kapoor Khan and Karisma Kapoor celebrated the festival together in matching yellow suits.
 Taking to Instagram, Kareena shared a picture with Karisma, giving fans a glimpse of their close bond. She captioned the post, "Diwali with behna."
 Diwali 2026: Kareena Kapoor Khan flaunts sindoor, poses with paps; Jeh wishes media 'Happy Diwali'; Randhir-Babita papped Instagram 
 In the photograph, Kareena was seen looking away from the camera, while Karisma posed with her eyes closed. Their coordinated festive outfits and warm moment together caught the attention of fans.
 View this post on Instagram A post shared by Bollywood Unfiltered (@bollywooduf) 
 Kareena -Karisma Kapoor attend Manish Malhotra's Diwali party 
 Apart from their private festive celebrations, the sisters also attended fashion designer Manish Malhotra's star-studded Diwali party in Mumbai on November 5.
 Kareena arrived at the celebration with husband Saif Ali Khan. The actress opted for a glamorous golden sequin saree teamed with a halter-neck blouse, while Saif kept his look traditional in a navy-blue kurta paired with white pyjamas.
 Karisma Kapoor also attended the gathering and made a statement in a black-and-white ethnic ensemble. She paired a heavily patterned blazer with a fitted skirt and kept her styling understated.
 View this post on Instagram A post shared by Instant Bollywood (@instantbollywood) 
 The celebration saw several prominent names from the film industry in attendance, including Aishwarya Rai Bachchan, Abhishek Bachchan, Akshay Kumar and  Madhuri Dixit, among others. 
 Kajol also shared glimpses from the Diwali celebration on social media, posting pictures and videos featuring moments with friends from the film industry, including Manish Malhotra, Karan Johar, Akshay Kumar and Twinkle Khanna.
